subject: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara@pioneerfin.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)

Team —

Quick context: Pioneer (large payments customer) is signing this week (SOW attached) and their legal/ops team has a hard requirement we support an "on-demand hot-swap" for model versions at tenant scope without an app restart. They want the ability to shift traffic to a pinned variant and back within <30s for failover or rapid rollbacks during production tuning.

This is not just a UI toggle — they care about deterministic cold-start behavior for the swapped model (KV warming strategy) and an auditable handoff for compliance. They are asking for delivery as part of our activation window (target go-live: 2027-09-10).

As the deal sponsor I'm asking Product + Eng: can we scope an MVP that satisfies the customer acceptance criteria below and provide an ETA and risk list by EOD Monday?

Acceptance criteria (customer):
- Model hot-swap can be initiated via API or Console and completes (traffic shift) within 30s
- Cold-start latency post-swap is bounded and documented for typical 2k req/day tenant
- Swap actions are logged (who/when/from IP) and surfaced in audit trail
- Fallback to previous model must be automated on health-check failure

Attachments: Pioneer_SOW_v3.pdf, Activation_Timeline_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I can join a sync if helpful.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Nguyen <sara@pioneerfin.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)

Laura — thanks for the heads-up and the clear acceptance criteria. High level: Product is supportive but we need engineering input on two unknowns before committing to a 2027-09-10 delivery.

Questions for Eng (Dev):
1) Is sub-30s traffic cutover feasible with our current KV cache architecture for a tenant-scale model?
2) Can we implement an audit event (swap.initiated / swap.completed / swap.rollback) with tenant metadata within one sprint if scoped to console + API only (no cross-region propagation initially)?
3) What operational controls do we need to guarantee deterministic cold-start (warmup hooks, prefetching batch requests, transient pre-residency)?

I propose an MVP that:
- exposes an API and console toggle (manual)
- runs an automated warmup job post-swap with a configurable warmup budget
- records swap events to our audit logs (no long-retention GCP export for MVP)

If Eng can confirm 1)–3) and estimate effort, Product will own the UI changes and acceptance test plan.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Product

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)

Quick engineering read — we can deliver a scoped MVP but there are tradeoffs and a non-trivial risk window. Answers inline: 

1) Sub-30s cutover: possible if we accept a two-stage switch where the control plane flips traffic immediately, and a background warmup job begins; for model sizes ~4–6GB quantized we can get 95th percentile cold-start down to ~12–18s on p4d with warmup. If the model is larger / on smaller hardware the window widens. Need to confirm Pioneer model size and target infra tier.

2) Audit events: trivial — we can emit structured events to audit-log pipeline in the same sprint.

3) Deterministic cold-start: requires a warmup harness (prefetch sample inputs) and an option to reserve a tiny warm pool slot for X seconds post-swap. Warm pool reservation increases cost exposure; need to sign off on an activation budget (estimated incremental cost: ~$1.2k/day on Dedicated mid-tier).

Estimate for MVP (API + Console + audit + warmup job, no cross-region replication):
- Eng implementation: 2.5 sprints (inc. testing)
- Product (UI/acceptance): 1 sprint
- SRE playbook + runbook: 0.5 sprint

Blockers/risks:
- Confirmation of model binary size and target hardware (Pioneer preference unknown)
- Approval for warm-pool budget or acceptance of transient cold-start for some infra tiers
- Security review timeline for making swap API user-facing (token scoping)

If Sales can accept a phased activation (MVP with manual toggle and audit, then automation for canary swaps in Q4), we can make the initial go-live date 2027-09-10 but will need a short EAP window and a follow-up sprint post-launch for robustness.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@pioneerfin.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)

Thanks — this aligns with our internal requirements. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Model size: initial model is ~4.8GB (quantized), will confirm exact artifacts by COB Wednesday.
- Budget: our security team will accept a short warm-pool budget for the activation week; I need a clear estimate we can include in our SOW addendum. The $1.2k/day figure is helpful — can you provide a breakdown (instance-hours, egress, ops) so finance can sign off?
- Audit retention: we need swap audit events retained for 13 months. If that is outside MVP, we need a documented path to get there.

We are comfortable with a manual toggle for initial activation if it helps speed delivery. We'll aim to provide the artifact by Wednesday.

—Sara Nguyen
Head of Platform Ops, Pioneer Financial

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Customer activation: on-demand model hot-swap for Pioneer Financial (timeline ask)

Summarizing next steps and owners: 
- Dev: confirm warmup cost breakdown (instance-hours, expected warm pool reservations) by EOD Wednesday 2027-08-25.
- Priyom/Marissa: prepare acceptance test plan + console mockups by Friday 2027-08-27.
- Sales (me): update SOW addendum with the activation budget once Dev provides numbers; will coordinate legal sign-off.
- Customer (Sara): provide model artifacts and final confirm on infra tier by COB Wednesday 2027-08-25.

If we hit those checkpoints, Product + Eng are comfortable with an MVP path and a controlled EAP. If any blocker hits (security review, model artifact missing), we escalate to the Deal Review committee.

I'll set a 30-min sync for Wednesday 08:30 PT to triage if needed — invite to follow.

Thanks,
—Laura

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
